blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Fewer passengers traveled from a bus terminal in Quezon City during this year’s Undas break, with rising fares cited as one possible reason. At the Solid North bus terminal in Cubao, there were more vacant seats in the waiting area than those already occupied by passengers around 9:20 a.m. on Sunday, which also falls on the commemoration of All Saints’ Day. According to Nelson Danieles, the terminal’s ticket master, around 599 passengers booked a trip to Baguio from Oct. 30, 11:30 p.m. to Oct. 31, 10 p.m. Meanwhile, approximately 2,100 passengers were bound to Pangasinan on Saturday.
